summary: The sandbox can signal the daemon. Containers run with pasta's host-loopback mapping (10.0.2.2) and the advertised control-plane URL defaults to it — before, anvilctl inside the sandbox pointed at the container's own 127.0.0.1 and every done claim died at the network boundary, reprompting forever. ANVIL_ADVERTISE_URL overrides the default for non-podman setups.
